card.name: Catheter and tube procedure instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces in instructions about catheters, tubes, infusion sites and bandages, just before a duration, step number or thing to check for.

modes.label: Check-site wording
modes.description: The word 'for' or 'be' after catheter, insertion site or tube, leading into what to look for or do.
modes.example: frequent checks of the parenteral access device and insertion site<< for>> edema, redness and discharge.

modes.label: Step or time number next
modes.description: A space before a number for a step or a time span in procedure directions.
modes.example: Repeat the procedure beginning with Step<< >>1 under Preparation of Solution.

modes.label: Start of complication word
modes.description: The opening piece of 'thrombophlebitis' in text about infusion-line risks.
